claims.quote: 2 antiretroviral medications with a long-acting suspension formulation: rilpivirine, a non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI), and cabotegravir, an integrase inhibitor.

claims.text: every 2 months, for adults on a stable regimen who are virologically suppressed.
claims.quote: The regimen can be administered as an intramuscular injection every 2 months. Patients with HIV infection who wish to consider this injectable regimen must be adults who are on an otherwise stable regimen and who are virologically suppressed

claims.text: Rilpivirine PO: 25 mg once daily with a meal (≥25 kg).
claims.quote: One 25 mg EDURANT tablet taken once daily with a meal for patients weighing at least 25 kg.

claims.text: CI with drugs that sharply lower rilpivirine levels through CYP3A induction or a higher gastric pH (loss of virologic response, possible resistance):
claims.quote: contraindicated for coadministration with the drugs in Table 2 for which significant decreases in rilpivirine plasma concentrations may occur due to CYP3A enzyme induction or gastric pH increase, which may result in loss of virologic response and possible resistance

claims.text: Antacids at least 2 h before or 4 h after rilpivirine.
claims.quote: (antacids taken at least 2 hours before or at least 4 hours after rilpivirine)

claims.text: Supratherapeutic doses prolong QTc; consider alternatives with drugs that carry a torsades risk.
claims.quote: 75 mg once daily and 300 mg once daily (3 times and 12 times the dose in EDURANT) have been shown to prolong the QTc interval of the electrocardiogram. Consider alternatives to EDURANT or EDURANT PED when coadministered with a drug that is known to have a risk of torsade de pointes
claims.locator: 5.4 Risk of Adverse Reactions or Loss of Virologic Response Due to Drug Interactions

claims.quote: Severe depressive disorders have been reported. Immediate medical evaluation is recommended for severe depressive disorders.

claims.text: Hepatotoxicity: check LFTs before and during treatment with HBV/HCV coinfection or marked transaminase elevation.
claims.quote: Monitor liver function tests before and during treatment with EDURANT or EDURANT PED in patients with underlying hepatic disease, such as hepatitis B or C virus co-infection, or marked elevations in transaminase.
